hero.title: Circulating trust as much as funding.
hero.intro: Jappandale is a Senegalese crowdfunding and financial matchmaking platform, designed to bring local projects closer to those who want to support them.
hero.imageAlt: Jappandale logo — connecting projects to funding opportunities

why.title: A local reality, a collective response
why.p1: In Senegal and across the WAEMU region, access to funding remains a major obstacle for many entrepreneurs, SMEs, cooperatives and associations.
why.p2: At the same time, the diaspora and local investors are looking for more structured ways to identify local projects, understand their needs and follow their progress.
why.p3: Jappandale creates this meeting point: a common framework to present, review, fund and follow impactful initiatives.

mission.title: Making funding clearer, closer and better followed

connect.title: Connect
connect.text: Bring together Senegalese project owners, contributors, investors and the diaspora around concrete opportunities.

evaluate.title: Review
evaluate.text: Check the identity of project owners and the consistency of their files before publication on the platform.

follow.title: Follow
follow.text: Make each project's goals, planned use of funds and reported progress visible.

roots.title: A platform built for the Senegalese ecosystem
roots.p1: Jappandale starts from the realities of the entrepreneurs, cooperatives, associations and communities who drive the local economy every day.
roots.p2: Our ambition is to put technology at the service of a more accessible financial relationship between local initiatives, the diaspora and their support communities.
roots.imageAlt: Economic activity in a Senegalese market

trustSection.title: Trust is built with evidence
trustSection.text: A verified campaign does not guarantee its success. It means the requested information and documents were reviewed before publication.
principles: Tracking accessible to project owners and contributors

cta.title: A project to grow, or an initiative to support?
cta.text: Join Jappandale to present your project, discover published campaigns and help them move forward.
